items.title: George Guesnon Interview
items.q: that sounded like Duke Ellington to me, you know, because them cats was really insane then.

ctx.x: Yes, very good. All right, let's see. Can you tell us a little bit more about your first days? How long did you stay there at the Hummingbird, and where did you go after that?

Well, I stood at the Hummingbird for about, I'll say, about nine months. And one night, John had some misunderstanding in the band, and to my surprise, Papa Salistad called me in the band. I was just that good. My name had began to spread, you see, because the cabaret used to open at night. But in the daytime, they had plenty of advertisement, plenty of jobs at Millenburg, all that in the day. So I was gigging with Rene, Buddy Petit, Chris, and all them outside, and my name began to spread. That guy plays a good…
